settings.heading: Let’s talk.
settings.text: A question about something you’ve seen, or a little help with an order? We’d love to hear from you.

settings.heading: A little help, when you need it.
settings.text: Use the form to send us a message. If you’re asking about an order, please include your order number.

settings.heading: About an order
settings.text: Your order number helps us find the details. You’ll find it in your confirmation email.

settings.heading: Before you ask
settings.text: Delivery, returns and payment questions? Our help centre is a good place to start.

settings.heading: Keep it private
settings.text: Please don’t send card numbers, passwords or other sensitive payment details.
